ivy: FYI I'm opening a small docs PR to harmonize SDK examples for streaming + pagination + retries across py/ts/go. will unify the resume token name to `cursor` and add a jitter helper.

ivy: link in PR when ready. main asks: 1) show resumable streams using `cursor` 2) recommend decorrelated jitter pattern 3) brief note about page_size vs max_tokens tradeoffs.

`tariq`: SG. I'll add a tiny unit test sketch that asserts resume uses server cursor.

`sam`: propose py jitter helper: def backoff_with_jitter(attempt, base=0.1, cap=5.0): exp = min(cap, base*(2**attempt)); return exp * random.uniform(0.5,1.0)

`luke`: TS async iterator draft: async function* pages(client, initialCursor=null) { let cursor=initialCursor; while (true) { const res = await client.stream({cursor}); yield res; if (!res.nextCursor) break; cursor = res.nextCursor; } }

`morgan`: Go snippet ok but use named param style in py (client.stream_messages(cursor=cursor)). also add note: respect Retry-After headers on rate limits.

`ivy`: added "Resuming streams" paragraph: server should resume exactly from `cursor` if provided; otherwise start from head. we call this out so integrators don't de-dupe externally.

`docs-bot`: PR draft updated with py/ts/go snippets and small test sketch. CI docs build passed on staging.

`morgan`: will do a quick typesetting pass and merge after tiny fixes. ETA today EOD.

`ivy`: thanks all — landing once morgan merges. :rocket:
